description: This file defines a pipeline for handling block reply messages, including buffering, coalescing, timeout management, and sending logic for reply payloads in a chat or messaging system.

methods.name: createAudioAsVoiceBuffer
methods.description: Creates a buffer that marks reply payloads with audioAsVoice if any payload enqueued has that property.

methods.name: createBlockReplyPayloadKey
methods.description: Generates a unique key for a reply payload based on its textual and media content, used for deduplication.

methods.name: createBlockReplyContentKey
methods.description: Creates a content-based key for reply payloads, ignoring replyToId, used for final payload suppression.

methods.name: createBlockReplyPipeline
methods.description: Constructs a reply message pipeline with buffering, coalescing, timeout, and sending capabilities.
